author: Nonprofit Client
title: 3D Character Illustrator for Nonprofit
content: We're seeking a talented 3D character illustrator/designer to create an original set of static characters for a children and family nonprofit. The style should feel cute, bubbly, and Pixar-inspired, with the warmth of a children's storybook. The project includes one main child character based on a real person and several playful companion characters with distinct shapes, textures, personalities, and a wide range of emotions. No animation is needed.

author: Lance
title: Epic Cover Album Artist Wanted
